programme.desc: Something as simple as a family picnic has an elegance in France. The entire family, unruly dogs included, head off for the picnic where Sarah tries to convince everyone that a baby goat should be in their future.

programme.title: Jamie's Quick & Easy Food

programme.title: Asia Unplated
programme.desc: Thai food is on the menu so Diana enlists the help of mentor and Thai food enthusiast, Gary Mehigan, who is an expert at striking the balance of salty, sweet and sour.
